og_title: AI-driven attackers got into Chainalysis, the firm that traces crypto crime | Warning Shots
og_desc: Chainalysis, whose tools law enforcement and crypto exchanges use to trace illicit money, says an attacker 'using offensive agentic techniques' got into its systems and exposed customers' names, emails and role labels. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 14 in a year. In 42% of the last 12 months' real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 167 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 31, 12:50 PM ET.
